🟡 GENTLE, NON-IRRITATING FORMULA - Provides optimal comfort during and after the treatment. The formula is well tolerated by the scalp.
🟡 RESULTS: Intense, deep color. Professional gray hair coverage Hydration, smoothing and protection
🟡 VARIETY OF COLORS - A palette of 24 colors - from silver, ash and new pink blondes, through intense reds and warm browns to deep blacks.
🟡 STRENGTHENING AND PROTECTION THANKS TO SERUM WITH 5 OILS!
Visit our store: Amazon.co.uk/Cameleo

directions.value: APPLICATION OF THE MIXTURE PREPARATION 1. Protect your clothing with a towel or cape and wear protective gloves. Do not cut the tip of the activator bottle applicator. 2. Unscrew the tube of hair dye and the cap of the activator bottle. Squeeze the entire contents of the dye tube into the activator bottle. Then add the entire contents of the oil sachet to the bottle. 3. Tightly close the bottle cap and shake vigorously for 1–2 minutes until a uniform cream is obtained. 4. Cut off the tip of the applicator. During this process, do not squeeze the bottle or point it toward your face, especially your eyes. Apply the mixture to the hair immediately after preparation. APPLICATION FOR FIRST-TIME COLORING 1. Comb the hair thoroughly before coloring. 2. Squeeze the prepared cream from the bottle in small amounts and distribute evenly with your fingers, working it into dry, unwashed hair. If hair gel, mousse, or hairspray has been used, or if the hair is very greasy, wash it with shampoo and lightly dry it with a hairdryer before coloring. 3. To ensure the cream is evenly distributed, comb the hair along its entire length after application. 4. Leave the mixture on the hair for 25–35 minutes. The color of the mixture may change during application, but this does not affect the final color result. 5. After the specified time, dampen the mixture on your hair with lukewarm water and massage until it forms a lather. Then rinse thoroughly. COLORING REGROWTH 1. Apply the freshly prepared mixture using the applicator only to the roots and massage it evenly into the hair. 2. Leave on for 20 minutes. 3. After the specified time, comb the hair strand by strand along the entire length and leave for an additional 10–15 minutes. USE OF CONDITIONER After rinsing the dye, apply the color-lock conditioner, massaging it into the hair. Leave for 2–3 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

safety_warning.value: For external use only

item_name.value: Cameleo - Permanent Hair Colour Cream - Copper Brown - Intensive Color & Protection - 5 Oils + Omega Plus Acids - Professional, Luxurious Hair Dye - Full Kit

directions.value: APPLICATION OF THE MIXTURE PREPARATION 1. Protect your clothing with a towel or cape and wear protective gloves. Do not cut the tip of the activator bottle applicator. 2. Unscrew the tube of hair dye and the cap of the activator bottle. Squeeze the entire contents of the dye tube into the activator bottle. Then add the entire contents of the oil sachet to the bottle. 3. Tightly close the bottle cap and shake vigorously for 1–2 minutes until a uniform cream is obtained. 4. Cut off the tip of the applicator. During this process, do not squeeze the bottle or point it toward your face, especially your eyes. Apply the mixture to the hair immediately after preparation. APPLICATION FOR FIRST-TIME COLORING 1. Comb the hair thoroughly before coloring. 2. Squeeze the prepared cream from the bottle in small amounts and distribute evenly with your fingers, working it into dry, unwashed hair. If hair gel, mousse, or hairspray has been used, or if the hair is very greasy, wash it with shampoo and lightly dry it with a hairdryer before coloring. 3. To ensure the cream is evenly distributed, comb the hair along its entire length after application. 4. Leave the mixture on the hair for 25–35 minutes. The color of the mixture may change during application, but this does not affect the final color result. 5. After the specified time, dampen the mixture on your hair with lukewarm water and massage until it forms a lather. Then rinse thoroughly. COLORING REGROWTH 1. Apply the freshly prepared mixture using the applicator only to the roots and massage it evenly into the hair. 2. Leave on for 20 minutes. 3. After the specified time, comb the hair strand by strand along the entire length and leave for an additional 10–15 minutes. USE OF CONDITIONER After rinsing the dye, apply the color-lock conditioner, massaging it into the hair. Leave for 2–3 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

safety_warning.value: For external use only

directions.value: APPLICATION OF THE MIXTURE PREPARATION 1. Protect your clothing with a towel or cape and wear protective gloves. Do not cut the tip of the activator bottle applicator. 2. Unscrew the tube of hair dye and the cap of the activator bottle. Squeeze the entire contents of the dye tube into the activator bottle. Then add the entire contents of the oil sachet to the bottle. 3. Tightly close the bottle cap and shake vigorously for 1–2 minutes until a uniform cream is obtained. 4. Cut off the tip of the applicator. During this process, do not squeeze the bottle or point it toward your face, especially your eyes. Apply the mixture to the hair immediately after preparation. APPLICATION FOR FIRST-TIME COLORING 1. Comb the hair thoroughly before coloring. 2. Squeeze the prepared cream from the bottle in small amounts and distribute evenly with your fingers, working it into dry, unwashed hair. If hair gel, mousse, or hairspray has been used, or if the hair is very greasy, wash it with shampoo and lightly dry it with a hairdryer before coloring. 3. To ensure the cream is evenly distributed, comb the hair along its entire length after application. 4. Leave the mixture on the hair for 25–35 minutes. The color of the mixture may change during application, but this does not affect the final color result. 5. After the specified time, dampen the mixture on your hair with lukewarm water and massage until it forms a lather. Then rinse thoroughly. COLORING REGROWTH 1. Apply the freshly prepared mixture using the applicator only to the roots and massage it evenly into the hair. 2. Leave on for 20 minutes. 3. After the specified time, comb the hair strand by strand along the entire length and leave for an additional 10–15 minutes. USE OF CONDITIONER After rinsing the dye, apply the color-lock conditioner, massaging it into the hair. Leave for 2–3 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

directions.value: APPLICATION OF THE MIXTURE PREPARATION 1. Protect your clothing with a towel or cape and wear protective gloves. Do not cut the tip of the activator bottle applicator. 2. Unscrew the tube of hair dye and the cap of the activator bottle. Squeeze the entire contents of the dye tube into the activator bottle. Then add the entire contents of the oil sachet to the bottle. 3. Tightly close the bottle cap and shake vigorously for 1–2 minutes until a uniform cream is obtained. 4. Cut off the tip of the applicator. During this process, do not squeeze the bottle or point it toward your face, especially your eyes. Apply the mixture to the hair immediately after preparation. APPLICATION FOR FIRST-TIME COLORING 1. Comb the hair thoroughly before coloring. 2. Squeeze the prepared cream from the bottle in small amounts and distribute evenly with your fingers, working it into dry, unwashed hair. If hair gel, mousse, or hairspray has been used, or if the hair is very greasy, wash it with shampoo and lightly dry it with a hairdryer before coloring. 3. To ensure the cream is evenly distributed, comb the hair along its entire length after application. 4. Leave the mixture on the hair for 25–35 minutes. The color of the mixture may change during application, but this does not affect the final color result. 5. After the specified time, dampen the mixture on your hair with lukewarm water and massage until it forms a lather. Then rinse thoroughly. COLORING REGROWTH 1. Apply the freshly prepared mixture using the applicator only to the roots and massage it evenly into the hair. 2. Leave on for 20 minutes. 3. After the specified time, comb the hair strand by strand along the entire length and leave for an additional 10–15 minutes. USE OF CONDITIONER After rinsing the dye, apply the color-lock conditioner, massaging it into the hair. Leave for 2–3 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

directions.value: APPLICATION OF THE MIXTURE PREPARATION 1. Protect your clothing with a towel or cape and wear protective gloves. Do not cut the tip of the activator bottle applicator. 2. Unscrew the tube of hair dye and the cap of the activator bottle. Squeeze the entire contents of the dye tube into the activator bottle. Then add the entire contents of the oil sachet to the bottle. 3. Tightly close the bottle cap and shake vigorously for 1–2 minutes until a uniform cream is obtained. 4. Cut off the tip of the applicator. During this process, do not squeeze the bottle or point it toward your face, especially your eyes. Apply the mixture to the hair immediately after preparation. APPLICATION FOR FIRST-TIME COLORING 1. Comb the hair thoroughly before coloring. 2. Squeeze the prepared cream from the bottle in small amounts and distribute evenly with your fingers, working it into dry, unwashed hair. If hair gel, mousse, or hairspray has been used, or if the hair is very greasy, wash it with shampoo and lightly dry it with a hairdryer before coloring. 3. To ensure the cream is evenly distributed, comb the hair along its entire length after application. 4. Leave the mixture on the hair for 25–35 minutes. The color of the mixture may change during application, but this does not affect the final color result. 5. After the specified time, dampen the mixture on your hair with lukewarm water and massage until it forms a lather. Then rinse thoroughly. COLORING REGROWTH 1. Apply the freshly prepared mixture using the applicator only to the roots and massage it evenly into the hair. 2. Leave on for 20 minutes. 3. After the specified time, comb the hair strand by strand along the entire length and leave for an additional 10–15 minutes. USE OF CONDITIONER After rinsing the dye, apply the color-lock conditioner, massaging it into the hair. Leave for 2–3 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

directions.value: APPLICATION OF THE MIXTURE PREPARATION 1. Protect your clothing with a towel or cape and wear protective gloves. Do not cut the tip of the activator bottle applicator. 2. Unscrew the tube of hair dye and the cap of the activator bottle. Squeeze the entire contents of the dye tube into the activator bottle. Then add the entire contents of the oil sachet to the bottle. 3. Tightly close the bottle cap and shake vigorously for 1–2 minutes until a uniform cream is obtained. 4. Cut off the tip of the applicator. During this process, do not squeeze the bottle or point it toward your face, especially your eyes. Apply the mixture to the hair immediately after preparation. APPLICATION FOR FIRST-TIME COLORING 1. Comb the hair thoroughly before coloring. 2. Squeeze the prepared cream from the bottle in small amounts and distribute evenly with your fingers, working it into dry, unwashed hair. If hair gel, mousse, or hairspray has been used, or if the hair is very greasy, wash it with shampoo and lightly dry it with a hairdryer before coloring. 3. To ensure the cream is evenly distributed, comb the hair along its entire length after application. 4. Leave the mixture on the hair for 25–35 minutes. The color of the mixture may change during application, but this does not affect the final color result. 5. After the specified time, dampen the mixture on your hair with lukewarm water and massage until it forms a lather. Then rinse thoroughly. COLORING REGROWTH 1. Apply the freshly prepared mixture using the applicator only to the roots and massage it evenly into the hair. 2. Leave on for 20 minutes. 3. After the specified time, comb the hair strand by strand along the entire length and leave for an additional 10–15 minutes. USE OF CONDITIONER After rinsing the dye, apply the color-lock conditioner, massaging it into the hair. Leave for 2–3 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

directions.value: APPLICATION OF THE MIXTURE PREPARATION 1. Protect your clothing with a towel or cape and wear protective gloves. Do not cut the tip of the activator bottle applicator. 2. Unscrew the tube of hair dye and the cap of the activator bottle. Squeeze the entire contents of the dye tube into the activator bottle. Then add the entire contents of the oil sachet to the bottle. 3. Tightly close the bottle cap and shake vigorously for 1–2 minutes until a uniform cream is obtained. 4. Cut off the tip of the applicator. During this process, do not squeeze the bottle or point it toward your face, especially your eyes. Apply the mixture to the hair immediately after preparation. APPLICATION FOR FIRST-TIME COLORING 1. Comb the hair thoroughly before coloring. 2. Squeeze the prepared cream from the bottle in small amounts and distribute evenly with your fingers, working it into dry, unwashed hair. If hair gel, mousse, or hairspray has been used, or if the hair is very greasy, wash it with shampoo and lightly dry it with a hairdryer before coloring. 3. To ensure the cream is evenly distributed, comb the hair along its entire length after application. 4. Leave the mixture on the hair for 25–35 minutes. The color of the mixture may change during application, but this does not affect the final color result. 5. After the specified time, dampen the mixture on your hair with lukewarm water and massage until it forms a lather. Then rinse thoroughly. COLORING REGROWTH 1. Apply the freshly prepared mixture using the applicator only to the roots and massage it evenly into the hair. 2. Leave on for 20 minutes. 3. After the specified time, comb the hair strand by strand along the entire length and leave for an additional 10–15 minutes. USE OF CONDITIONER After rinsing the dye, apply the color-lock conditioner, massaging it into the hair. Leave for 2–3 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

safety_warning.value: For external use only

directions.value: APPLICATION OF THE MIXTURE PREPARATION 1. Protect your clothing with a towel or cape and wear protective gloves. Do not cut the tip of the activator bottle applicator. 2. Unscrew the tube of hair dye and the cap of the activator bottle. Squeeze the entire contents of the dye tube into the activator bottle. Then add the entire contents of the oil sachet to the bottle. 3. Tightly close the bottle cap and shake vigorously for 1–2 minutes until a uniform cream is obtained. 4. Cut off the tip of the applicator. During this process, do not squeeze the bottle or point it toward your face, especially your eyes. Apply the mixture to the hair immediately after preparation. APPLICATION FOR FIRST-TIME COLORING 1. Comb the hair thoroughly before coloring. 2. Squeeze the prepared cream from the bottle in small amounts and distribute evenly with your fingers, working it into dry, unwashed hair. If hair gel, mousse, or hairspray has been used, or if the hair is very greasy, wash it with shampoo and lightly dry it with a hairdryer before coloring. 3. To ensure the cream is evenly distributed, comb the hair along its entire length after application. 4. Leave the mixture on the hair for 25–35 minutes. The color of the mixture may change during application, but this does not affect the final color result. 5. After the specified time, dampen the mixture on your hair with lukewarm water and massage until it forms a lather. Then rinse thoroughly. COLORING REGROWTH 1. Apply the freshly prepared mixture using the applicator only to the roots and massage it evenly into the hair. 2. Leave on for 20 minutes. 3. After the specified time, comb the hair strand by strand along the entire length and leave for an additional 10–15 minutes. USE OF CONDITIONER After rinsing the dye, apply the color-lock conditioner, massaging it into the hair. Leave for 2–3 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

directions.value: APPLICATION OF THE MIXTURE PREPARATION 1. Protect your clothing with a towel or cape and wear protective gloves. Do not cut the tip of the activator bottle applicator. 2. Unscrew the tube of hair dye and the cap of the activator bottle. Squeeze the entire contents of the dye tube into the activator bottle. Then add the entire contents of the oil sachet to the bottle. 3. Tightly close the bottle cap and shake vigorously for 1–2 minutes until a uniform cream is obtained. 4. Cut off the tip of the applicator. During this process, do not squeeze the bottle or point it toward your face, especially your eyes. Apply the mixture to the hair immediately after preparation. APPLICATION FOR FIRST-TIME COLORING 1. Comb the hair thoroughly before coloring. 2. Squeeze the prepared cream from the bottle in small amounts and distribute evenly with your fingers, working it into dry, unwashed hair. If hair gel, mousse, or hairspray has been used, or if the hair is very greasy, wash it with shampoo and lightly dry it with a hairdryer before coloring. 3. To ensure the cream is evenly distributed, comb the hair along its entire length after application. 4. Leave the mixture on the hair for 25–35 minutes. The color of the mixture may change during application, but this does not affect the final color result. 5. After the specified time, dampen the mixture on your hair with lukewarm water and massage until it forms a lather. Then rinse thoroughly. COLORING REGROWTH 1. Apply the freshly prepared mixture using the applicator only to the roots and massage it evenly into the hair. 2. Leave on for 20 minutes. 3. After the specified time, comb the hair strand by strand along the entire length and leave for an additional 10–15 minutes. USE OF CONDITIONER After rinsing the dye, apply the color-lock conditioner, massaging it into the hair. Leave for 2–3 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

safety_warning.value: For external use only

directions.value: APPLICATION OF THE MIXTURE PREPARATION 1. Protect your clothing with a towel or cape and wear protective gloves. Do not cut the tip of the activator bottle applicator. 2. Unscrew the tube of hair dye and the cap of the activator bottle. Squeeze the entire contents of the dye tube into the activator bottle. Then add the entire contents of the oil sachet to the bottle. 3. Tightly close the bottle cap and shake vigorously for 1–2 minutes until a uniform cream is obtained. 4. Cut off the tip of the applicator. During this process, do not squeeze the bottle or point it toward your face, especially your eyes. Apply the mixture to the hair immediately after preparation. APPLICATION FOR FIRST-TIME COLORING 1. Comb the hair thoroughly before coloring. 2. Squeeze the prepared cream from the bottle in small amounts and distribute evenly with your fingers, working it into dry, unwashed hair. If hair gel, mousse, or hairspray has been used, or if the hair is very greasy, wash it with shampoo and lightly dry it with a hairdryer before coloring. 3. To ensure the cream is evenly distributed, comb the hair along its entire length after application. 4. Leave the mixture on the hair for 25–35 minutes. The color of the mixture may change during application, but this does not affect the final color result. 5. After the specified time, dampen the mixture on your hair with lukewarm water and massage until it forms a lather. Then rinse thoroughly. COLORING REGROWTH 1. Apply the freshly prepared mixture using the applicator only to the roots and massage it evenly into the hair. 2. Leave on for 20 minutes. 3. After the specified time, comb the hair strand by strand along the entire length and leave for an additional 10–15 minutes. USE OF CONDITIONER After rinsing the dye, apply the color-lock conditioner, massaging it into the hair. Leave for 2–3 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

safety_warning.value: For external use only

directions.value: APPLICATION OF THE MIXTURE PREPARATION 1. Protect your clothing with a towel or cape and wear protective gloves. Do not cut the tip of the activator bottle applicator. 2. Unscrew the tube of hair dye and the cap of the activator bottle. Squeeze the entire contents of the dye tube into the activator bottle. Then add the entire contents of the oil sachet to the bottle. 3. Tightly close the bottle cap and shake vigorously for 1–2 minutes until a uniform cream is obtained. 4. Cut off the tip of the applicator. During this process, do not squeeze the bottle or point it toward your face, especially your eyes. Apply the mixture to the hair immediately after preparation. APPLICATION FOR FIRST-TIME COLORING 1. Comb the hair thoroughly before coloring. 2. Squeeze the prepared cream from the bottle in small amounts and distribute evenly with your fingers, working it into dry, unwashed hair. If hair gel, mousse, or hairspray has been used, or if the hair is very greasy, wash it with shampoo and lightly dry it with a hairdryer before coloring. 3. To ensure the cream is evenly distributed, comb the hair along its entire length after application. 4. Leave the mixture on the hair for 25–35 minutes. The color of the mixture may change during application, but this does not affect the final color result. 5. After the specified time, dampen the mixture on your hair with lukewarm water and massage until it forms a lather. Then rinse thoroughly. COLORING REGROWTH 1. Apply the freshly prepared mixture using the applicator only to the roots and massage it evenly into the hair. 2. Leave on for 20 minutes. 3. After the specified time, comb the hair strand by strand along the entire length and leave for an additional 10–15 minutes. USE OF CONDITIONER After rinsing the dye, apply the color-lock conditioner, massaging it into the hair. Leave for 2–3 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

safety_warning.value: For external use only

directions.value: APPLICATION OF THE MIXTURE PREPARATION 1. Protect your clothing with a towel or cape and wear protective gloves. Do not cut the tip of the activator bottle applicator. 2. Unscrew the tube of hair dye and the cap of the activator bottle. Squeeze the entire contents of the dye tube into the activator bottle. Then add the entire contents of the oil sachet to the bottle. 3. Tightly close the bottle cap and shake vigorously for 1–2 minutes until a uniform cream is obtained. 4. Cut off the tip of the applicator. During this process, do not squeeze the bottle or point it toward your face, especially your eyes. Apply the mixture to the hair immediately after preparation. APPLICATION FOR FIRST-TIME COLORING 1. Comb the hair thoroughly before coloring. 2. Squeeze the prepared cream from the bottle in small amounts and distribute evenly with your fingers, working it into dry, unwashed hair. If hair gel, mousse, or hairspray has been used, or if the hair is very greasy, wash it with shampoo and lightly dry it with a hairdryer before coloring. 3. To ensure the cream is evenly distributed, comb the hair along its entire length after application. 4. Leave the mixture on the hair for 25–35 minutes. The color of the mixture may change during application, but this does not affect the final color result. 5. After the specified time, dampen the mixture on your hair with lukewarm water and massage until it forms a lather. Then rinse thoroughly. COLORING REGROWTH 1. Apply the freshly prepared mixture using the applicator only to the roots and massage it evenly into the hair. 2. Leave on for 20 minutes. 3. After the specified time, comb the hair strand by strand along the entire length and leave for an additional 10–15 minutes. USE OF CONDITIONER After rinsing the dye, apply the color-lock conditioner, massaging it into the hair. Leave for 2–3 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

safety_warning.value: For external use only

directions.value: APPLICATION OF THE MIXTURE PREPARATION 1. Protect your clothing with a towel or cape and wear protective gloves. Do not cut the tip of the activator bottle applicator. 2. Unscrew the tube of hair dye and the cap of the activator bottle. Squeeze the entire contents of the dye tube into the activator bottle. Then add the entire contents of the oil sachet to the bottle. 3. Tightly close the bottle cap and shake vigorously for 1–2 minutes until a uniform cream is obtained. 4. Cut off the tip of the applicator. During this process, do not squeeze the bottle or point it toward your face, especially your eyes. Apply the mixture to the hair immediately after preparation. APPLICATION FOR FIRST-TIME COLORING 1. Comb the hair thoroughly before coloring. 2. Squeeze the prepared cream from the bottle in small amounts and distribute evenly with your fingers, working it into dry, unwashed hair. If hair gel, mousse, or hairspray has been used, or if the hair is very greasy, wash it with shampoo and lightly dry it with a hairdryer before coloring. 3. To ensure the cream is evenly distributed, comb the hair along its entire length after application. 4. Leave the mixture on the hair for 25–35 minutes. The color of the mixture may change during application, but this does not affect the final color result. 5. After the specified time, dampen the mixture on your hair with lukewarm water and massage until it forms a lather. Then rinse thoroughly. COLORING REGROWTH 1. Apply the freshly prepared mixture using the applicator only to the roots and massage it evenly into the hair. 2. Leave on for 20 minutes. 3. After the specified time, comb the hair strand by strand along the entire length and leave for an additional 10–15 minutes. USE OF CONDITIONER After rinsing the dye, apply the color-lock conditioner, massaging it into the hair. Leave for 2–3 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

safety_warning.value: For external use only

directions.value: APPLICATION OF THE MIXTURE PREPARATION 1. Protect your clothing with a towel or cape and wear protective gloves. Do not cut the tip of the activator bottle applicator. 2. Unscrew the tube of hair dye and the cap of the activator bottle. Squeeze the entire contents of the dye tube into the activator bottle. Then add the entire contents of the oil sachet to the bottle. 3. Tightly close the bottle cap and shake vigorously for 1–2 minutes until a uniform cream is obtained. 4. Cut off the tip of the applicator. During this process, do not squeeze the bottle or point it toward your face, especially your eyes. Apply the mixture to the hair immediately after preparation. APPLICATION FOR FIRST-TIME COLORING 1. Comb the hair thoroughly before coloring. 2. Squeeze the prepared cream from the bottle in small amounts and distribute evenly with your fingers, working it into dry, unwashed hair. If hair gel, mousse, or hairspray has been used, or if the hair is very greasy, wash it with shampoo and lightly dry it with a hairdryer before coloring. 3. To ensure the cream is evenly distributed, comb the hair along its entire length after application. 4. Leave the mixture on the hair for 25–35 minutes. The color of the mixture may change during application, but this does not affect the final color result. 5. After the specified time, dampen the mixture on your hair with lukewarm water and massage until it forms a lather. Then rinse thoroughly. COLORING REGROWTH 1. Apply the freshly prepared mixture using the applicator only to the roots and massage it evenly into the hair. 2. Leave on for 20 minutes. 3. After the specified time, comb the hair strand by strand along the entire length and leave for an additional 10–15 minutes. directions.value: APPLICATION OF THE MIXTURE PREPARATION 1. Protect your clothing with a towel or cape and wear protective gloves. Do not cut the tip of the activator bottle applicator. 2. Unscrew the tube of hair dye and the cap of the activator bottle. Squeeze the entire contents of the dye tube into the activator bottle. Then add the entire contents of the oil sachet to the bottle. 3. Tightly close the bottle cap and shake vigorously for 1–2 minutes until a uniform cream is obtained. 4. Cut off the tip of the applicator. During this process, do not squeeze the bottle or point it toward your face, especially your eyes. Apply the mixture to the hair immediately after preparation. APPLICATION FOR FIRST-TIME COLORING 1. Comb the hair thoroughly before coloring. 2. Squeeze the prepared cream from the bottle in small amounts and distribute evenly with your fingers, working it into dry, unwashed hair. If hair gel, mousse, or hairspray has been used, or if the hair is very greasy, wash it with shampoo and lightly dry it with a hairdryer before coloring. 3. To ensure the cream is evenly distributed, comb the hair along its entire length after application. 4. Leave the mixture on the hair for 25–35 minutes. The color of the mixture may change during application, but this does not affect the final color result. 5. After the specified time, dampen the mixture on your hair with lukewarm water and massage until it forms a lather. Then rinse thoroughly. COLORING REGROWTH 1. Apply the freshly prepared mixture using the applicator only to the roots and massage it evenly into the hair. 2. Leave on for 20 minutes. 3. After the specified time, comb the hair strand by strand along the entire length and leave for an additional 10–15 minutes. USE OF CONDITIONER After rinsing the dye, apply the color-lock conditioner, massaging it into the hair. Leave for 2–3 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

directions.value: APPLICATION OF THE MIXTURE PREPARATION 1. Protect your clothing with a towel or cape and wear protective gloves. Do not cut the tip of the activator bottle applicator. 2. Unscrew the tube of hair dye and the cap of the activator bottle. Squeeze the entire contents of the dye tube into the activator bottle. Then add the entire contents of the oil sachet to the bottle. 3. Tightly close the bottle cap and shake vigorously for 1–2 minutes until a uniform cream is obtained. 4. Cut off the tip of the applicator. During this process, do not squeeze the bottle or point it toward your face, especially your eyes. Apply the mixture to the hair immediately after preparation. APPLICATION FOR FIRST-TIME COLORING 1. Comb the hair thoroughly before coloring. 2. Squeeze the prepared cream from the bottle in small amounts and distribute evenly with your fingers, working it into dry, unwashed hair. If hair gel, mousse, or hairspray has been used, or if the hair is very greasy, wash it with shampoo and lightly dry it with a hairdryer before coloring. 3. To ensure the cream is evenly distributed, comb the hair along its entire length after application. 4. Leave the mixture on the hair for 25–35 minutes. The color of the mixture may change during application, but this does not affect the final color result. 5. After the specified time, dampen the mixture on your hair with lukewarm water and massage until it forms a lather. Then rinse thoroughly. COLORING REGROWTH 1. Apply the freshly prepared mixture using the applicator only to the roots and massage it evenly into the hair. 2. Leave on for 20 minutes. 3. After the specified time, comb the hair strand by strand along the entire length and leave for an additional 10–15 minutes. USE OF CONDITIONER After rinsing the dye, apply the color-lock conditioner, massaging it into the hair. Leave for 2–3 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

directions.value: APPLICATION OF THE MIXTURE PREPARATION 1. Protect your clothing with a towel or cape and wear protective gloves. Do not cut the tip of the activator bottle applicator. 2. Unscrew the tube of hair dye and the cap of the activator bottle. Squeeze the entire contents of the dye tube into the activator bottle. Then add the entire contents of the oil sachet to the bottle. 3. Tightly close the bottle cap and shake vigorously for 1–2 minutes until a uniform cream is obtained. 4. Cut off the tip of the applicator. During this process, do not squeeze the bottle or point it toward your face, especially your eyes. Apply the mixture to the hair immediately after preparation. APPLICATION FOR FIRST-TIME COLORING 1. Comb the hair thoroughly before coloring. 2. Squeeze the prepared cream from the bottle in small amounts and distribute evenly with your fingers, working it into dry, unwashed hair. If hair gel, mousse, or hairspray has been used, or if the hair is very greasy, wash it with shampoo and lightly dry it with a hairdryer before coloring. 3. To ensure the cream is evenly distributed, comb the hair along its entire length after application. 4. Leave the mixture on the hair for 25–35 minutes. The color of the mixture may change during application, but this does not affect the final color result. 5. After the specified time, dampen the mixture on your hair with lukewarm water and massage until it forms a lather. Then rinse thoroughly. COLORING REGROWTH 1. Apply the freshly prepared mixture using the applicator only to the roots and massage it evenly into the hair. 2. Leave on for 20 minutes. 3. After the specified time, comb the hair strand by strand along the entire length and leave for an additional 10–15 minutes. USE OF CONDITIONER After rinsing the dye, apply the color-lock conditioner, massaging it into the hair. Leave for 2–3 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

directions.value: APPLICATION OF THE MIXTURE PREPARATION 1. Protect your clothing with a towel or cape and wear protective gloves. Do not cut the tip of the activator bottle applicator. 2. Cut off the tip of the applicator. During this process, do not squeeze the bottle or point it toward your face, especially your eyes. Apply the mixture to the hair immediately after preparation. APPLICATION FOR FIRST-TIME COLORING 1. Comb the hair thoroughly before coloring. 2. Squeeze the prepared cream from the bottle in small amounts and distribute evenly with your fingers, working it into dry, unwashed hair. If hair gel, mousse, or hairspray has been used, or if the hair is very greasy, wash it with shampoo and lightly dry it with a hairdryer before coloring. 3. To ensure the cream is evenly distributed, comb the hair along its entire length after application. 4. Leave the mixture on the hair for 25–35 minutes. The color of the mixture may change during application, but this does not affect the final color result. 5. After the specified time, dampen the mixture on your hair with lukewarm water and massage until it forms a lather. Then rinse thoroughly. COLORING REGROWTH 1. Apply the freshly prepared mixture using the applicator only to the roots and massage it evenly into the hair. 2. Leave on for 20 minutes. 3. After the specified time, comb the hair strand by strand along the entire length and leave for an additional 10–15 minutes. directions.value: APPLICATION OF THE MIXTURE PREPARATION 1. Protect your clothing with a towel or cape and wear protective gloves. Do not cut the tip of the activator bottle applicator. 2. Unscrew the tube of hair dye and the cap of the activator bottle. Squeeze the entire contents of the dye tube into the activator bottle. Cut off the tip of the applicator. During this process, do not squeeze the bottle or point it toward your face, especially your eyes. Apply the mixture to the hair immediately after preparation. APPLICATION FOR FIRST-TIME COLORING 1. Comb the hair thoroughly before coloring. 2. Squeeze the prepared cream from the bottle in small amounts and distribute evenly with your fingers, working it into dry, unwashed hair. If hair gel, mousse, or hairspray has been used, or if the hair is very greasy, wash it with shampoo and lightly dry it with a hairdryer before coloring. 3. To ensure the cream is evenly distributed, comb the hair along its entire length after application. 4. Leave the mixture on the hair for 25–35 minutes. The color of the mixture may change during application, but this does not affect the final color result. 5. After the specified time, dampen the mixture on your hair with lukewarm water and massage until it forms a lather. Then rinse thoroughly. COLORING REGROWTH 1. Apply the freshly prepared mixture using the applicator only to the roots and massage it evenly into the hair. 2. Leave on for 20 minutes. 3. After the specified time, comb the hair strand by strand along the entire length and leave for an additional 10–15 minutes. USE OF CONDITIONER After rinsing the dye, apply the color-lock conditioner, massaging it into the hair. Leave for 2–3 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

directions.value: APPLICATION OF THE MIXTURE PREPARATION 1. Protect your clothing with a towel or cape and wear protective gloves. Do not cut the tip of the activator bottle applicator. 2. Unscrew the tube of hair dye and the cap of the activator bottle. Squeeze the entire contents of the dye tube into the activator bottle. Then add the entire contents of the oil sachet to the bottle. 3. Tightly close the bottle cap and shake vigorously for 1–2 minutes until a uniform cream is obtained. 4. Cut off the tip of the applicator. During this process, do not squeeze the bottle or point it toward your face, especially your eyes. Apply the mixture to the hair immediately after preparation. APPLICATION FOR FIRST-TIME COLORING 1. Comb the hair thoroughly before coloring. 2. Squeeze the prepared cream from the bottle in small amounts and distribute evenly with your fingers, working it into dry, unwashed hair. If hair gel, mousse, or hairspray has been used, or if the hair is very greasy, wash it with shampoo and lightly dry it with a hairdryer before coloring. 3. To ensure the cream is evenly distributed, comb the hair along its entire length after application. 4. Leave the mixture on the hair for 25–35 minutes. The color of the mixture may change during application, but this does not affect the final color result. 5. After the specified time, dampen the mixture on your hair with lukewarm water and massage until it forms a lather. Then rinse thoroughly. COLORING REGROWTH 1. Apply the freshly prepared mixture using the applicator only to the roots and massage it evenly into the hair. 2. Leave on for 20 minutes. 3. After the specified time, comb the hair strand by strand along the entire length and leave for an additional 10–15 minutes. USE OF CONDITIONER After rinsing the dye, apply the color-lock conditioner, massaging it into the hair. Leave for 2–3 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

directions.value: APPLICATION OF THE MIXTURE PREPARATION 1. Protect your clothing with a towel or cape and wear protective gloves. Do not cut the tip of the activator bottle applicator. 2. Unscrew the tube of hair dye and the cap of the activator bottle. Squeeze the entire contents of the dye tube into the activator bottle. Then add the entire contents of the oil sachet to the bottle. 3. Tightly close the bottle cap and shake vigorously for 1–2 minutes until a uniform cream is obtained. 4. Cut off the tip of the applicator. During this process, do not squeeze the bottle or point it toward your face, especially your eyes. Apply the mixture to the hair immediately after preparation. APPLICATION FOR FIRST-TIME COLORING 1. Comb the hair thoroughly before coloring. 2. Squeeze the prepared cream from the bottle in small amounts and distribute evenly with your fingers, working it into dry, unwashed hair. If hair gel, mousse, or hairspray has been used, or if the hair is very greasy, wash it with shampoo and lightly dry it with a hairdryer before coloring. 3. To ensure the cream is evenly distributed, comb the hair along its entire length after application. 4. Leave the mixture on the hair for 25–35 minutes. The color of the mixture may change during application, but this does not affect the final color result. 5. After the specified time, dampen the mixture on your hair with lukewarm water and massage until it forms a lather. Then rinse thoroughly. COLORING REGROWTH 1. Apply the freshly prepared mixture using the applicator only to the roots and massage it evenly into the hair. 2. Leave on for 20 minutes. 3. After the specified time, comb the hair strand by strand along the entire length and leave for an additional 10–15 minutes. USE OF CONDITIONER After rinsing the dye, apply the color-lock conditioner, massaging it into the hair. Leave for 2–3 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

directions.value: APPLICATION OF THE MIXTURE PREPARATION 1. Protect your clothing with a towel or cape and wear protective gloves. Do not cut the tip of the activator bottle applicator. 2. Unscrew the tube of hair dye and the cap of the activator bottle. Squeeze the entire contents of the dye tube into the activator bottle. Then add the entire contents of the oil sachet to the bottle. 3. Tightly close the bottle cap and shake vigorously for 1–2 minutes until a uniform cream is obtained. 4. Cut off the tip of the applicator. During this process, do not squeeze the bottle or point it toward your face, especially your eyes. Apply the mixture to the hair immediately after preparation. APPLICATION FOR FIRST-TIME COLORING 1. Comb the hair thoroughly before coloring. 2. Squeeze the prepared cream from the bottle in small amounts and distribute evenly with your fingers, working it into dry, unwashed hair. If hair gel, mousse, or hairspray has been used, or if the hair is very greasy, wash it with shampoo and lightly dry it with a hairdryer before coloring. 3. To ensure the cream is evenly distributed, comb the hair along its entire length after application. 4. Leave the mixture on the hair for 25–35 minutes. The color of the mixture may change during application, but this does not affect the final color result. 5. After the specified time, dampen the mixture on your hair with lukewarm water and massage until it forms a lather. Then rinse thoroughly. COLORING REGROWTH 1. Apply the freshly prepared mixture using the applicator only to the roots and massage it evenly into the hair. 2. Leave on for 20 minutes. 3. After the specified time, comb the hair strand by strand along the entire length and leave for an additional 10–15 minutes. USE OF CONDITIONER After rinsing the dye, apply the color-lock conditioner, massaging it into the hair. Leave for 2–3 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

directions.value: APPLICATION OF THE MIXTURE PREPARATION 1. Protect your clothing with a towel or cape and wear protective gloves. Do not cut the tip of the activator bottle applicator. 2. Unscrew the tube of hair dye and the cap of the activator bottle. Squeeze the entire contents of the dye tube into the activator bottle. Then add the entire contents of the oil sachet to the bottle. 3. Tightly close the bottle cap and shake vigorously for 1–2 minutes until a uniform cream is obtained. 4. Cut off the tip of the applicator. During this process, do not squeeze the bottle or point it toward your face, especially your eyes. Apply the mixture to the hair immediately after preparation. APPLICATION FOR FIRST-TIME COLORING 1. Comb the hair thoroughly before coloring. 2. Squeeze the prepared cream from the bottle in small amounts and distribute evenly with your fingers, working it into dry, unwashed hair. If hair gel, mousse, or hairspray has been used, or if the hair is very greasy, wash it with shampoo and lightly dry it with a hairdryer before coloring. 3. To ensure the cream is evenly distributed, comb the hair along its entire length after application. 4. Leave the mixture on the hair for 25–35 minutes. The color of the mixture may change during application, but this does not affect the final color result. 5. After the specified time, dampen the mixture on your hair with lukewarm water and massage until it forms a lather. Then rinse thoroughly. COLORING REGROWTH 1. Apply the freshly prepared mixture using the applicator only to the roots and massage it evenly into the hair. 2. Leave on for 20 minutes. 3. After the specified time, comb the hair strand by strand along the entire length and leave for an additional 10–15 minutes. USE OF CONDITIONER After rinsing the dye, apply the color-lock conditioner, massaging it into the hair. Leave for 2–3 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

directions.value: APPLICATION OF THE MIXTURE PREPARATION 1. Protect your clothing with a towel or cape and wear protective gloves. Do not cut the tip of the activator bottle applicator. 2. Unscrew the tube of hair dye and the cap of the activator bottle. Squeeze the entire contents of the dye tube into the activator bottle. Then add the entire contents of the oil sachet to the bottle. 3. Tightly close the bottle cap and shake vigorously for 1–2 minutes until a uniform cream is obtained. 4. Cut off the tip of the applicator. During this process, do not squeeze the bottle or point it toward your face, especially your eyes. Apply the mixture to the hair immediately after preparation. APPLICATION FOR FIRST-TIME COLORING 1. Comb the hair thoroughly before coloring. 2. Squeeze the prepared cream from the bottle in small amounts and distribute evenly with your fingers, working it into dry, unwashed hair. If hair gel, mousse, or hairspray has been used, or if the hair is very greasy, wash it with shampoo and lightly dry it with a hairdryer before coloring. 3. To ensure the cream is evenly distributed, comb the hair along its entire length after application. 4. Leave the mixture on the hair for 25–35 minutes. The color of the mixture may change during application, but this does not affect the final color result. 5. After the specified time, dampen the mixture on your hair with lukewarm water and massage until it forms a lather. Then rinse thoroughly. COLORING REGROWTH 1. Apply the freshly prepared mixture using the applicator only to the roots and massage it evenly into the hair. 2. Leave on for 20 minutes. 3. After the specified time, comb the hair strand by strand along the entire length and leave for an additional 10–15 minutes. USE OF CONDITIONER After rinsing the dye, apply the color-lock conditioner, massaging it into the hair. Leave for 2–3 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

directions.value: APPLICATION OF THE MIXTURE PREPARATION 1. Protect your clothing with a towel or cape and wear protective gloves. Do not cut the tip of the activator bottle applicator. 2. Unscrew the tube of hair dye and the cap of the activator bottle. Squeeze the entire contents of the dye tube into the activator bottle. Then add the entire contents of the oil sachet to the bottle. 3. Tightly close the bottle cap and shake vigorously for 1–2 minutes until a uniform cream is obtained. 4. Cut off the tip of the applicator. During this process, do not squeeze the bottle or point it toward your face, especially your eyes. Apply the mixture to the hair immediately after preparation. APPLICATION FOR FIRST-TIME COLORING 1. Comb the hair thoroughly before coloring. 2. Squeeze the prepared cream from the bottle in small amounts and distribute evenly with your fingers, working it into dry, unwashed hair. If hair gel, mousse, or hairspray has been used, or if the hair is very greasy, wash it with shampoo and lightly dry it with a hairdryer before coloring. 3. To ensure the cream is evenly distributed, comb the hair along its entire length after application. 4. Leave the mixture on the hair for 25–35 minutes. The color of the mixture may change during application, but this does not affect the final color result. 5. After the specified time, dampen the mixture on your hair with lukewarm water and massage until it forms a lather. Then rinse thoroughly. COLORING REGROWTH 1. Apply the freshly prepared mixture using the applicator only to the roots and massage it evenly into the hair. 2. Leave on for 20 minutes. 3. After the specified time, comb the hair strand by strand along the entire length and leave for an additional 10–15 minutes. USE OF CONDITIONER After rinsing the dye, apply the color-lock conditioner, massaging it into the hair. Leave for 2–3 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

directions.value: APPLICATION OF THE MIXTURE PREPARATION 1. Protect your clothing with a towel or cape and wear protective gloves. Do not cut the tip of the activator bottle applicator. 2. Unscrew the tube of hair dye and the cap of the activator bottle. Squeeze the entire contents of the dye tube into the activator bottle. Then add the entire contents of the oil sachet to the bottle. 3. Tightly close the bottle cap and shake vigorously for 1–2 minutes until a uniform cream is obtained. 4. Cut off the tip of the applicator. During this process, do not squeeze the bottle or point it toward your face, especially your eyes. Apply the mixture to the hair immediately after preparation. APPLICATION FOR FIRST-TIME COLORING 1. Comb the hair thoroughly before coloring. 2. Squeeze the prepared cream from the bottle in small amounts and distribute evenly with your fingers, working it into dry, unwashed hair. If hair gel, mousse, or hairspray has been used, or if the hair is very greasy, wash it with shampoo and lightly dry it with a hairdryer before coloring. 3. To ensure the cream is evenly distributed, comb the hair along its entire length after application. 4. Leave the mixture on the hair for 25–35 minutes. The color of the mixture may change during application, but this does not affect the final color result. 5. After the specified time, dampen the mixture on your hair with lukewarm water and massage until it forms a lather. Then rinse thoroughly. COLORING REGROWTH 1. Apply the freshly prepared mixture using the applicator only to the roots and massage it evenly into the hair. 2. Leave on for 20 minutes. 3. After the specified time, comb the hair strand by strand along the entire length and leave for an additional 10–15 minutes. USE OF CONDITIONER After rinsing the dye, apply the color-lock conditioner, massaging it into the hair. Leave for 2–3 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

directions.value: APPLICATION OF THE MIXTURE PREPARATION 1. Protect your clothing with a towel or cape and wear protective gloves. Do not cut the tip of the activator bottle applicator. 2. Unscrew the tube of hair dye and the cap of the activator bottle. Squeeze the entire contents of the dye tube into the activator bottle. Then add the entire contents of the oil sachet to the bottle. 3. Tightly close the bottle cap and shake vigorously for 1–2 minutes until a uniform cream is obtained. 4. Cut off the tip of the applicator. During this process, do not squeeze the bottle or point it toward your face, especially your eyes. Apply the mixture to the hair immediately after preparation. APPLICATION FOR FIRST-TIME COLORING 1. Comb the hair thoroughly before coloring. 2. Squeeze the prepared cream from the bottle in small amounts and distribute evenly with your fingers, working it into dry, unwashed hair. If hair gel, mousse, or hairspray has been used, or if the hair is very greasy, wash it with shampoo and lightly dry it with a hairdryer before coloring. 3. To ensure the cream is evenly distributed, comb the hair along its entire length after application. 4. Leave the mixture on the hair for 25–35 minutes. The color of the mixture may change during application, but this does not affect the final color result. 5. After the specified time, dampen the mixture on your hair with lukewarm water and massage until it forms a lather. Then rinse thoroughly. COLORING REGROWTH 1. Apply the freshly prepared mixture using the applicator only to the roots and massage it evenly into the hair. 2. Leave on for 20 minutes. 3. After the specified time, comb the hair strand by strand along the entire length and leave for an additional 10–15 minutes. USE OF CONDITIONER After rinsing the dye, apply the color-lock conditioner, massaging it into the hair. Leave for 2–3 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

directions.value: APPLICATION OF THE MIXTURE PREPARATION 1. Protect your clothing with a towel or cape and wear protective gloves. Do not cut the tip of the activator bottle applicator. 2. Unscrew the tube of hair dye and the cap of the activator bottle. Squeeze the entire contents of the dye tube into the activator bottle. Then add the entire contents of the oil sachet to the bottle. 3. Tightly close the bottle cap and shake vigorously for 1–2 minutes until a uniform cream is obtained. 4. Cut off the tip of the applicator. During this process, do not squeeze the bottle or point it toward your face, especially your eyes. Apply the mixture to the hair immediately after preparation. APPLICATION FOR FIRST-TIME COLORING 1. Comb the hair thoroughly before coloring. 2. Squeeze the prepared cream from the bottle in small amounts and distribute evenly with your fingers, working it into dry, unwashed hair. If hair gel, mousse, or hairspray has been used, or if the hair is very greasy, wash it with shampoo and lightly dry it with a hairdryer before coloring. 3. To ensure the cream is evenly distributed, comb the hair along its entire length after application. 4. Leave the mixture on the hair for 25–35 minutes. The color of the mixture may change during application, but this does not affect the final color result. 5. After the specified time, dampen the mixture on your hair with lukewarm water and massage until it forms a lather. Then rinse thoroughly. COLORING REGROWTH 1. Apply the freshly prepared mixture using the applicator only to the roots and massage it evenly into the hair. 2. Leave on for 20 minutes. 3. After the specified time, comb the hair strand by strand along the entire length and leave for an additional 10–15 minutes. USE OF CONDITIONER After rinsing the dye, apply the color-lock conditioner, massaging it into the hair. Leave for 2–3 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

safety_warning.value: For external use only

directions.value: APPLICATION OF THE MIXTURE PREPARATION 1. Protect your clothing with a towel or cape and wear protective gloves. Do not cut the tip of the activator bottle applicator. 2. Unscrew the tube of hair dye and the cap of the activator bottle. Squeeze the entire contents of the dye tube into the activator bottle. Then add the entire contents of the oil sachet to the bottle. 3. Tightly close the bottle cap and shake vigorously for 1–2 minutes until a uniform cream is obtained. 4. Cut off the tip of the applicator. During this process, do not squeeze the bottle or point it toward your face, especially your eyes. Apply the mixture to the hair immediately after preparation. APPLICATION FOR FIRST-TIME COLORING 1. Comb the hair thoroughly before coloring. 2. Squeeze the prepared cream from the bottle in small amounts and distribute evenly with your fingers, working it into dry, unwashed hair. If hair gel, mousse, or hairspray has been used, or if the hair is very greasy, wash it with shampoo and lightly dry it with a hairdryer before coloring. 3. To ensure the cream is evenly distributed, comb the hair along its entire length after application. 4. Leave the mixture on the hair for 25–35 minutes. The color of the mixture may change during application, but this does not affect the final color result. 5. After the specified time, dampen the mixture on your hair with lukewarm water and massage until it forms a lather. Then rinse thoroughly. COLORING REGROWTH 1. Apply the freshly prepared mixture using the applicator only to the roots and massage it evenly into the hair. 2. Leave on for 20 minutes. 3. After the specified time, comb the hair strand by strand along the entire length and leave for an additional 10–15 minutes. USE OF CONDITIONER After rinsing the dye, apply the color-lock conditioner, massaging it into the hair. Leave for 2–3 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

directions.value: APPLICATION OF THE MIXTURE PREPARATION 1. Protect your clothing with a towel or cape and wear protective gloves. Do not cut the tip of the activator bottle applicator. 2. Unscrew the tube of hair dye and the cap of the activator bottle. Squeeze the entire contents of the dye tube into the activator bottle. Then add the entire contents of the oil sachet to the bottle. 3. Tightly close the bottle cap and shake vigorously for 1–2 minutes until a uniform cream is obtained. 4. Cut off the tip of the applicator. During this process, do not squeeze the bottle or point it toward your face, especially your eyes. Apply the mixture to the hair immediately after preparation. APPLICATION FOR FIRST-TIME COLORING 1. Comb the hair thoroughly before coloring. 2. Squeeze the prepared cream from the bottle in small amounts and distribute evenly with your fingers, working it into dry, unwashed hair. If hair gel, mousse, or hairspray has been used, or if the hair is very greasy, wash it with shampoo and lightly dry it with a hairdryer before coloring. 3. To ensure the cream is evenly distributed, comb the hair along its entire length after application. 4. Leave the mixture on the hair for 25–35 minutes. The color of the mixture may change during application, but this does not affect the final color result. 5. After the specified time, dampen the mixture on your hair with lukewarm water and massage until it forms a lather. Then rinse thoroughly. COLORING REGROWTH 1. Apply the freshly prepared mixture using the applicator only to the roots and massage it evenly into the hair. 2. Leave on for 20 minutes. 3. After the specified time, comb the hair strand by strand along the entire length and leave for an additional 10–15 minutes. USE OF CONDITIONER After rinsing the dye, apply the color-lock conditioner, massaging it into the hair. Leave for 2–3 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

directions.value: APPLICATION OF THE MIXTURE PREPARATION 1. Protect your clothing with a towel or cape and wear protective gloves. Do not cut the tip of the activator bottle applicator. 2. Unscrew the tube of hair dye and the cap of the activator bottle. Squeeze the entire contents of the dye tube into the activator bottle. Then add the entire contents of the oil sachet to the bottle. 3. Tightly close the bottle cap and shake vigorously for 1–2 minutes until a uniform cream is obtained. 4. Cut off the tip of the applicator. During this process, do not squeeze the bottle or point it toward your face, especially your eyes. Apply the mixture to the hair immediately after preparation. APPLICATION FOR FIRST-TIME COLORING 1. Comb the hair thoroughly before coloring. 2. Squeeze the prepared cream from the bottle in small amounts and distribute evenly with your fingers, working it into dry, unwashed hair. If hair gel, mousse, or hairspray has been used, or if the hair is very greasy, wash it with shampoo and lightly dry it with a hairdryer before coloring. 3. To ensure the cream is evenly distributed, comb the hair along its entire length after application. 4. Leave the mixture on the hair for 25–35 minutes. The color of the mixture may change during application, but this does not affect the final color result. 5. After the specified time, dampen the mixture on your hair with lukewarm water and massage until it forms a lather. Then rinse thoroughly. COLORING REGROWTH 1. Apply the freshly prepared mixture using the applicator only to the roots and massage it evenly into the hair. 2. Leave on for 20 minutes. 3. After the specified time, comb the hair strand by strand along the entire length and leave for an additional 10–15 minutes. USE OF CONDITIONER After rinsing the dye, apply the color-lock conditioner, massaging it into the hair. Leave for 2–3 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

directions.value: APPLICATION OF THE MIXTURE PREPARATION 1. Protect your clothing with a towel or cape and wear protective gloves. Do not cut the tip of the activator bottle applicator. 2. Unscrew the tube of hair dye and the cap of the activator bottle. Squeeze the entire contents of the dye tube into the activator bottle. Then add the entire contents of the oil sachet to the bottle. 3. Tightly close the bottle cap and shake vigorously for 1–2 minutes until a uniform cream is obtained. 4. Cut off the tip of the applicator. During this process, do not squeeze the bottle or point it toward your face, especially your eyes. Apply the mixture to the hair immediately after preparation. APPLICATION FOR FIRST-TIME COLORING 1. Comb the hair thoroughly before coloring. 2. Squeeze the prepared cream from the bottle in small amounts and distribute evenly with your fingers, working it into dry, unwashed hair. If hair gel, mousse, or hairspray has been used, or if the hair is very greasy, wash it with shampoo and lightly dry it with a hairdryer before coloring. 3. To ensure the cream is evenly distributed, comb the hair along its entire length after application. 4. Leave the mixture on the hair for 25–35 minutes. The color of the mixture may change during application, but this does not affect the final color result. 5. After the specified time, dampen the mixture on your hair with lukewarm water and massage until it forms a lather. Then rinse thoroughly. COLORING REGROWTH 1. Apply the freshly prepared mixture using the applicator only to the roots and massage it evenly into the hair. 2. Leave on for 20 minutes. 3. After the specified time, comb the hair strand by strand along the entire length and leave for an additional 10–15 minutes. USE OF CONDITIONER After rinsing the dye, apply the color-lock conditioner, massaging it into the hair. Leave for 2–3 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

directions.value: APPLICATION OF THE MIXTURE PREPARATION 1. Protect your clothing with a towel or cape and wear protective gloves. Do not cut the tip of the activator bottle applicator. 2. Unscrew the tube of hair dye and the cap of the activator bottle. Squeeze the entire contents of the dye tube into the activator bottle. Then add the entire contents of the oil sachet to the bottle. 3. Tightly close the bottle cap and shake vigorously for 1–2 minutes until a uniform cream is obtained. 4. Cut off the tip of the applicator. During this process, do not squeeze the bottle or point it toward your face, especially your eyes. Apply the mixture to the hair immediately after preparation. APPLICATION FOR FIRST-TIME COLORING 1. Comb the hair thoroughly before coloring. 2. Squeeze the prepared cream from the bottle in small amounts and distribute evenly with your fingers, working it into dry, unwashed hair. If hair gel, mousse, or hairspray has been used, or if the hair is very greasy, wash it with shampoo and lightly dry it with a hairdryer before coloring. 3. To ensure the cream is evenly distributed, comb the hair along its entire length after application. 4. Leave the mixture on the hair for 25–35 minutes. The color of the mixture may change during application, but this does not affect the final color result. 5. After the specified time, dampen the mixture on your hair with lukewarm water and massage until it forms a lather. Then rinse thoroughly. COLORING REGROWTH 1. Apply the freshly prepared mixture using the applicator only to the roots and massage it evenly into the hair. 2. Leave on for 20 minutes. 3. After the specified time, comb the hair strand by strand along the entire length and leave for an additional 10–15 minutes. USE OF CONDITIONER After rinsing the dye, apply the color-lock conditioner, massaging it into the hair. Leave for 2–3 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

directions.value: APPLICATION OF THE MIXTURE PREPARATION 1. Protect your clothing with a towel or cape and wear protective gloves. Do not cut the tip of the activator bottle applicator. 2. Unscrew the tube of hair dye and the cap of the activator bottle. Squeeze the entire contents of the dye tube into the activator bottle. Then add the entire contents of the oil sachet to the bottle. 3. Tightly close the bottle cap and shake vigorously for 1–2 minutes until a uniform cream is obtained. 4. Cut off the tip of the applicator. During this process, do not squeeze the bottle or point it toward your face, especially your eyes. Apply the mixture to the hair immediately after preparation. APPLICATION FOR FIRST-TIME COLORING 1. Comb the hair thoroughly before coloring. 2. Squeeze the prepared cream from the bottle in small amounts and distribute evenly with your fingers, working it into dry, unwashed hair. If hair gel, mousse, or hairspray has been used, or if the hair is very greasy, wash it with shampoo and lightly dry it with a hairdryer before coloring. 3. To ensure the cream is evenly distributed, comb the hair along its entire length after application. 4. Leave the mixture on the hair for 25–35 minutes. The color of the mixture may change during application, but this does not affect the final color result. 5. After the specified time, dampen the mixture on your hair with lukewarm water and massage until it forms a lather. Then rinse thoroughly. COLORING REGROWTH 1. Apply the freshly prepared mixture using the applicator only to the roots and massage it evenly into the hair. 2. Leave on for 20 minutes. 3. After the specified time, comb the hair strand by strand along the entire length and leave for an additional 10–15 minutes. USE OF CONDITIONER After rinsing the dye, apply the color-lock conditioner, massaging it into the hair. Leave for 2–3 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

safety_warning.value: For external use only

directions.value: APPLICATION OF THE MIXTURE PREPARATION 1. Protect your clothing with a towel or cape and wear protective gloves. Do not cut the tip of the activator bottle applicator. 2. Unscrew the tube of hair dye and the cap of the activator bottle. Squeeze the entire contents of the dye tube into the activator bottle. Then add the entire contents of the oil sachet to the bottle. 3. Tightly close the bottle cap and shake vigorously for 1–2 minutes until a uniform cream is obtained. 4. Cut off the tip of the applicator. During this process, do not squeeze the bottle or point it toward your face, especially your eyes. Apply the mixture to the hair immediately after preparation. APPLICATION FOR FIRST-TIME COLORING 1. Comb the hair thoroughly before coloring. 2. Squeeze the prepared cream from the bottle in small amounts and distribute evenly with your fingers, working it into dry, unwashed hair. If hair gel, mousse, or hairspray has been used, or if the hair is very greasy, wash it with shampoo and lightly dry it with a hairdryer before coloring. 3. To ensure the cream is evenly distributed, comb the hair along its entire length after application. 4. Leave the mixture on the hair for 25–35 minutes. The color of the mixture may change during application, but this does not affect the final color result. 5. After the specified time, dampen the mixture on your hair with lukewarm water and massage until it forms a lather. Then rinse thoroughly. COLORING REGROWTH 1. Apply the freshly prepared mixture using the applicator only to the roots and massage it evenly into the hair. 2. Leave on for 20 minutes. 3. After the specified time, comb the hair strand by strand along the entire length and leave for an additional 10–15 minutes. USE OF CONDITIONER After rinsing the dye, apply the color-lock conditioner, massaging it into the hair. Leave for 2–3 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

directions.value: APPLICATION OF THE MIXTURE PREPARATION 1. Protect your clothing with a towel or cape and wear protective gloves. Do not cut the tip of the activator bottle applicator. 2. Unscrew the tube of hair dye and the cap of the activator bottle. Squeeze the entire contents of the dye tube into the activator bottle. Then add the entire contents of the oil sachet to the bottle. 3. Tightly close the bottle cap and shake vigorously for 1–2 minutes until a uniform cream is obtained. 4. Cut off the tip of the applicator. During this process, do not squeeze the bottle or point it toward your face, especially your eyes. Apply the mixture to the hair immediately after preparation. APPLICATION FOR FIRST-TIME COLORING 1. Comb the hair thoroughly before coloring. 2. Squeeze the prepared cream from the bottle in small amounts and distribute evenly with your fingers, working it into dry, unwashed hair. If hair gel, mousse, or hairspray has been used, or if the hair is very greasy, wash it with shampoo and lightly dry it with a hairdryer before coloring. 3. To ensure the cream is evenly distributed, comb the hair along its entire length after application. 4. Leave the mixture on the hair for 25–35 minutes. The color of the mixture may change during application, but this does not affect the final color result. 5. After the specified time, dampen the mixture on your hair with lukewarm water and massage until it forms a lather. Then rinse thoroughly. COLORING REGROWTH 1. Apply the freshly prepared mixture using the applicator only to the roots and massage it evenly into the hair. 2. Leave on for 20 minutes. 3. After the specified time, comb the hair strand by strand along the entire length and leave for an additional 10–15 minutes. USE OF CONDITIONER After rinsing the dye, apply the color-lock conditioner, massaging it into the hair. Leave for 2–3 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

directions.value: APPLICATION OF THE MIXTURE PREPARATION 1. Protect your clothing with a towel or cape and wear protective gloves. Do not cut the tip of the activator bottle applicator. 2. Unscrew the tube of hair dye and the cap of the activator bottle. Squeeze the entire contents of the dye tube into the activator bottle. Then add the entire contents of the oil sachet to the bottle. 3. Tightly close the bottle cap and shake vigorously for 1–2 minutes until a uniform cream is obtained. 4. Cut off the tip of the applicator. During this process, do not squeeze the bottle or point it toward your face, especially your eyes. Apply the mixture to the hair immediately after preparation. APPLICATION FOR FIRST-TIME COLORING 1. Comb the hair thoroughly before coloring. 2. Squeeze the prepared cream from the bottle in small amounts and distribute evenly with your fingers, working it into dry, unwashed hair. If hair gel, mousse, or hairspray has been used, or if the hair is very greasy, wash it with shampoo and lightly dry it with a hairdryer before coloring. 3. To ensure the cream is evenly distributed, comb the hair along its entire length after application. 4. Leave the mixture on the hair for 25–35 minutes. The color of the mixture may change during application, but this does not affect the final color result. 5. After the specified time, dampen the mixture on your hair with lukewarm water and massage until it forms a lather. Then rinse thoroughly. COLORING REGROWTH 1. Apply the freshly prepared mixture using the applicator only to the roots and massage it evenly into the hair. 2. Leave on for 20 minutes. 3. After the specified time, comb the hair strand by strand along the entire length and leave for an additional 10–15 minutes. USE OF CONDITIONER After rinsing the dye, apply the color-lock conditioner, massaging it into the hair. Leave for 2–3 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

Then add the entire contents of the oil sachet to the bottle. 3. Tightly close the bottle cap and shake vigorously for 1–2 minutes until a uniform cream is obtained. 4. Cut off the tip of the applicator. During this process, do not squeeze the bottle or point it toward your face, especially your eyes. Apply the mixture to the hair immediately after preparation. APPLICATION FOR FIRST-TIME COLORING 1. Comb the hair thoroughly before coloring. 2. Squeeze the prepared cream from the bottle in small amounts and distribute evenly with your fingers, working it into dry, unwashed hair. If hair gel, mousse, or hairspray has been used, or if the hair is very greasy, wash it with shampoo and lightly dry it with a hairdryer before coloring. 3. To ensure the cream is evenly distributed, comb the hair along its entire length after application. 4. Leave the mixture on the hair for 25–35 minutes. The color of the mixture may change during application, but this does not affect the final color result. 5. After the specified time, dampen the mixture on your hair with lukewarm water and massage until it forms a lather. Then rinse thoroughly. COLORING REGROWTH 1. Apply the freshly prepared mixture using the applicator only to the roots and massage it evenly into the hair. 2. Leave on for 20 minutes. 3. After the specified time, comb the hair strand by strand along the entire length and leave for an additional 10–15 minutes. USE OF CONDITIONER After rinsing the dye, apply the color-lock conditioner, massaging it into the hair. Leave for 2–3 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

directions.value: APPLICATION OF THE MIXTURE PREPARATION 1. Protect your clothing with a towel or cape and wear protective gloves. Do not cut the tip of the activator bottle applicator. 2. Unscrew the tube of hair dye and the cap of the activator bottle. Squeeze the entire contents of the dye tube into the activator bottle. Then add the entire contents of the oil sachet to the bottle. 3. Tightly close the bottle cap and shake vigorously for 1–2 minutes until a uniform cream is obtained. 4. Cut off the tip of the applicator. During this process, do not squeeze the bottle or point it toward your face, especially your eyes. Apply the mixture to the hair immediately after preparation. APPLICATION FOR FIRST-TIME COLORING 1. Comb the hair thoroughly before coloring. 2. Squeeze the prepared cream from the bottle in small amounts and distribute evenly with your fingers, working it into dry, unwashed hair. If hair gel, mousse, or hairspray has been used, or if the hair is very greasy, wash it with shampoo and lightly dry it with a hairdryer before coloring. 3. To ensure the cream is evenly distributed, comb the hair along its entire length after application. 4. Leave the mixture on the hair for 25–35 minutes. The color of the mixture may change during application, but this does not affect the final color result. 5. After the specified time, dampen the mixture on your hair with lukewarm water and massage until it forms a lather. Then rinse thoroughly. COLORING REGROWTH 1. Apply the freshly prepared mixture using the applicator only to the roots and massage it evenly into the hair. 2. Leave on for 20 minutes. 3. After the specified time, comb the hair strand by strand along the entire length and leave for an additional 10–15 minutes. USE OF CONDITIONER After rinsing the dye, apply the color-lock conditioner, massaging it into the hair. Leave for 2–3 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

directions.value: APPLICATION OF THE MIXTURE PREPARATION 1. Protect your clothing with a towel or cape and wear protective gloves. Do not cut the tip of the activator bottle applicator. 2. Unscrew the tube of hair dye and the cap of the activator bottle. Squeeze the entire contents of the dye tube into the activator bottle. Then add the entire contents of the oil sachet to the bottle. 3. Tightly close the bottle cap and shake vigorously for 1–2 minutes until a uniform cream is obtained. 4. Cut off the tip of the applicator. During this process, do not squeeze the bottle or point it toward your face, especially your eyes. Apply the mixture to the hair immediately after preparation. APPLICATION FOR FIRST-TIME COLORING 1. Comb the hair thoroughly before coloring. 2. Squeeze the prepared cream from the bottle in small amounts and distribute evenly with your fingers, working it into dry, unwashed hair. If hair gel, mousse, or hairspray has been used, or if the hair is very greasy, wash it with shampoo and lightly dry it with a hairdryer before coloring. 3. To ensure the cream is evenly distributed, comb the hair along its entire length after application. 4. Leave the mixture on the hair for 25–35 minutes. The color of the mixture may change during application, but this does not affect the final color result. 5. After the specified time, dampen the mixture on your hair with lukewarm water and massage until it forms a lather. Then rinse thoroughly. COLORING REGROWTH 1. Apply the freshly prepared mixture using the applicator only to the roots and massage it evenly into the hair. 2. Leave on for 20 minutes. 3. After the specified time, comb the hair strand by strand along the entire length and leave for an additional 10–15 minutes. USE OF CONDITIONER After rinsing the dye, apply the color-lock conditioner, massaging it into the hair. Leave for 2–3 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

directions.value: APPLICATION OF THE MIXTURE PREPARATION 1. Protect your clothing with a towel or cape and wear protective gloves. Do not cut the tip of the activator bottle applicator. 2. Unscrew the tube of hair dye and the cap of the activator bottle. Squeeze the entire contents of the dye tube into the activator bottle. Then add the entire contents of the oil sachet to the bottle. 3. Tightly close the bottle cap and shake vigorously for 1–2 minutes until a uniform cream is obtained. 4. Cut off the tip of the applicator. During this process, do not squeeze the bottle or point it toward your face, especially your eyes. Apply the mixture to the hair immediately after preparation. APPLICATION FOR FIRST-TIME COLORING 1. Comb the hair thoroughly before coloring. 2. Squeeze the prepared cream from the bottle in small amounts and distribute evenly with your fingers, working it into dry, unwashed hair. If hair gel, mousse, or hairspray has been used, or if the hair is very greasy, wash it with shampoo and lightly dry it with a hairdryer before coloring. 3. To ensure the cream is evenly distributed, comb the hair along its entire length after application. 4. Leave the mixture on the hair for 25–35 minutes. The color of the mixture may change during application, but this does not affect the final color result. 5. After the specified time, dampen the mixture on your hair with lukewarm water and massage until it forms a lather. Then rinse thoroughly. COLORING REGROWTH 1. Apply the freshly prepared mixture using the applicator only to the roots and massage it evenly into the hair. 2. Leave on for 20 minutes. 3. After the specified time, comb the hair strand by strand along the entire length and leave for an additional 10–15 minutes. USE OF CONDITIONER After rinsing the dye, apply the color-lock conditioner, massaging it into the hair. Leave for 2–3 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.
